levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «رويته عن أبي- رضي اللّه عنه-» : the compiler's father, named only as «أبي»: a relation link; the blessing is left out
the chain runs Saduq, then his father, Sa'd, Muhammad b. al-Husayn, al-Hakam, and Umar b. Abi Ziyad last; «عمر بن أبي زياد» is written twice, the second is the link (occurrence 2)
